name: Loe Bar
depth: 'good depth of water off the Bar' (first pass, Sea Angler snippet)
features: Fixed-venue club competition mark every November and April (MBAS); coordinates are used as the photo code
fishes_well_in: Club runs its Nov comp here regardless of weather windows (Fri evening to Sun evening); NOT FOUND which wind/swell

species.name: Lesser spotted dogfish
species.notes: Loe Bar comp 2023: LSD 1029g (Ed Polley, 16 Nov 2023 per MBAS Nov-2023 recorder return); 2024: LSD 955g (17 Nov 2024), 825g (17 Nov 2024); 2025: LSD 1070g and 980g (Loe Bar comp Nov 2025, exact day not found); recorder returns do not name venue, comp results do

species.name: Whiting
species.notes: 483g (16 Nov 2023), 250g (17 Nov 2024), 510g (Nov 2025) - the only fish over club min size in 2023 comp; 'quite a lot of small fish caught'

species.name: Small-eyed ray
species.notes: 4447g, Shaun Parkinson, Loe Bar comp Nov 2025 (date not found); winner

size_potential: Small-eyed ray 4.447 kg, LSD ~1.0-1.07 kg, whiting to ~0.5 kg in three November comps; comps are small fields so absence of cod is not evidence
notes: UPGRADE: three consecutive years of DATED mid/late-Nov comp results naming Loe Bar (2023, 2024, 2025) plus the 2026 comp scheduled Fri 27 - Sun 29 Nov 2026, i.e. the weekend after the target date. Outcomes are poor-moderate (club's own wording 2023: 'quite a lot of small fish'; Nov 2024 'Storm Bert makes fishing difficult'). No cod reported in any of the three comps - contradicts first-pass 'cod' hint (Sea Angler snippet, undated). Grade A for recorder dates, B for news text; fish dates in recorder returns match comp weekend but returns do not name venue (D inference that the 16/17 Nov fish are the comp fish, supported by identical weights).
